title: The Man in Apartment 703
content_zh:
Detective Emma Torres was paid to follow people. But she had never been asked to investigate her own building — or the man in 703, the one with the perfect smile who always held the elevator door. The anonymous letter simply said: 'He is not who he says he is.'
She started with public records. The apartment was rented by one James Chen, 34, software consultant, no criminal record, credit score 810. Too perfect. Emma had been a cop for ten years. Nobody's life was that clean.
She dug deeper. His consulting firm did not exist. His college degree was fabricated. The social security number belonged to a man who had died in 1997. Emma felt the familiar thrill of the hunt — and a new, unfamiliar feeling: fear. Because whoever James Chen really was, he had gone to enormous trouble to hide it, and some secrets were worth killing for.
